'''Rilly Raadun''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Force Adept]], who lived during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
In [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], Raadun attended the [[SoroSuub Anniversary celebration, 31 BBY|SoroSuub Anniversary celebration]] that was held in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Tolea Biqua]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Genarius]]. During the event, Raadun served as an [[Agent/Legends|agent]] of the Force Adept [[Taleah Novran]], who was trying to pair young Force Adepts with suitable mentors.

==Personality and traits==
Raadun was very energetic and capable of carrying out many different tasks simultaneously. She was also very kind and friendly, and would care and feed those who she felt needed her help.
